title: Marvel vs DC
shortAnswer: Marvel has dominated the modern era with the MCU ($30B+ box office) led by Iron Man, Avengers, and Spider-Man. DC has deeper comic book roots (Superman was 1938, Batman 1939) and iconic characters but the DCEU has been less consistent. Marvel wins at movies; DC wins in animated and some comics.
verdict: Marvel dominates the modern cinematic universe. DC has the more iconic individual characters. Marvel wins the box office; DC wins the comics legacy debate.

lines.hook: Thirty billion dollars at the box office. DC hasn't cracked a quarter of it.
lines.tape: One built the better movie machine. The other invented the whole idea of superheroes.
rounds: Marvel out-earned DC by over four to one. That's not rivalry, that's a gap.
Endgame made more than double Aquaman. DC's best night was Marvel's Tuesday.
Superman landed in 1938, a year before Marvel had anybody. DC started the genre.
The DC animated universe is the gold standard. Marvel's cartoons never got close.
Marvel edges the comic shelf too, but DC is right behind it.
lines.verdict: Marvel takes it 3-2. Pick DC if you want the characters that outlive the movies.

youtubeTitle: Marvel vs DC: Who Actually Wins the Superhero War?
youtubeDescription:
We compare Marvel and DC across box office totals, biggest films, character history, animated universes, and comic sales. The MCU's $30B dwarfs the DCEU's $7B, but DC owns the older characters and the better animation. Full head-to-head breakdown and a final verdict.

Figures accurate as of October 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/marvel-vs-dc
